conviction_note: Q3 net sales and active customers are already out (7 Oct trading update, stock -12.5% that day and -17% since), so the release adds Q3 EBIT and the Q4 outlook. EBIT probably improves y/y on lower acquisition spend (+1.0); the Q4 growth guide is probably soft after a 9% drop in active customers (-1.5). Those offset, so p_up is 50 and the scaled number is 0. The size is large anyway: this name's last four report days moved -11.2%, +12.8%, +20.9% and -2.9%, and it gives a quarterly outlook in every report. The findings sum to -0.5 against a scaled 0 because the soft guide is the likelier line but has partly been priced by the 17% fall since the update.

Q4 2026 outlook, which the company gives in every report (in Q3 2025 it guided high single-digit growth and a slightly lower margin, and the stock fell 11%). With active customers down 9% and acquisition back at 2024 levels, I expect low single-digit Q4 growth against a record Q4 2025 EBIT of MSEK 36.8, probably with profitability language attached. Leans down

findings.finding: Q3 2026 EBIT is likely to improve materially from MSEK -5.3, because last year's Q3 carried a 64% acquisition surge (S&M MSEK 38.3, 14.4% of sales, contribution margin 27.1%), new-customer volume this Q3 was 39% lower, and the CEO said in the trading update that 'even modest growth is lifting profitability'.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: EBIT surprises that the trading update had not pre-released were bought: the Q4 2025 preliminary EBIT 'ahead of plan' gave +15.7% on 2026-01-19, and the Q1 2026 record EBIT gave +20.9% on its report day. But the Q3 2025 EBIT, pre-guided at about MSEK -5 in the update, was ignored on report day (-11.2%, on the Q4 guide), and Q2 2026 EBIT beat Redeye by 18% yet the stock fell 2.9%.
findings.original_quote: "Vi investerar i kundanskaffning med fokus på avkastning snarare än enbart volym, och även en måttlig tillväxt förbättrar lönsamheten" (We invest in customer acquisition for return rather than volume alone, and even moderate growth improves profitability)
findings.why_not_priced: The trading update gave no EBIT this time, where the Q3 2025 update did (about MSEK -5), so the profit line is the one Q3 number the market has not been told. The tape priced the update as a growth miss (-12.5% on 772k shares, about 30x normal volume, then a slide to 92.4) and not as a profit improvement. If the improvement were priced, the stock would not have kept drifting through October on low volume. Caveat: the company pre-released Q4 2025 EBIT when it was 'higher than anticipated' and has issued nothing for Q3, so EBIT is probably not far outside what management expected. That keeps this finding small.
findings.independence: The cost-structure arithmetic comes from the Q3 2025 report table (S&M -38,251 KSEK, contribution margin 27.1%; https://storage.mfn.se/57c2d0b5-4215-458d-a998-4a6f7d62e46f/q3-2025-cheffelo-eng-final.pdf), and the Q2 2026 report shows S&M falling to 6.5% of sales with EBIT doubling (https://storage.mfn.se/2d02cf58-26cf-4fff-ae00-ce1ada3c225c/q2-2026-cheffelo-eng.pdf). Both are the company's own documents, so this is not independent of the issuer.

findings.finding: The Q4 2026 outlook, which Cheffelo gives in every report and which drove the -11.2% on the Q3 2025 report day, is likely to point to low single-digit growth: active customers ended Q3 down 9.1% y/y at 77.5k, against a Q4 2025 base of 78.4k that last year's acquisition surge inflated, and the largest peer (HelloFresh) warned on 2026-09-25 of weak back-to-school customer acquisition.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Outlook lines decide this stock's report days. Q3 2025: the Q4 guide (high single-digit growth, slightly lower margin) took the stock -11.2% despite a pre-released strong quarter (Redeye: 'the market appears to have reacted negatively to the Q4 outlook'). Q1 2026: the H1 growth guide of 14-18% was followed by +20.9%. Q2 2026: 'growth over the second half to be lower' was followed by -2.9%.
findings.original_quote: Swedish version: "Aktiva kunder under tredje kvartalet var 77,5 tusen (85,2), en minskning om 9,1% mot föregående år ... I år var antalet nya kunder under tredje kvartalet i nivå med tredje kvartalet 2024, men 39% lägre än under tredje kvartalet 2025."
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the stock is -17% since the update and -25% over 60 days, so a low Q4 number is not a surprise. What is not yet out is whether management puts a number below the 7-9% long-term growth target on Q4 for the first time since the 2025 target reset. If the market had fully priced a sub-target guide, Redeye would not still have stood behind its SEK 157 fair value after the update, and the stock would have stabilised rather than drifting lower into the print. Sized small because it is an inference from customer counts plus a peer, and the slide may already have absorbed it.
findings.independence: HelloFresh's ad-hoc of 2026-09-25 cut its Q3 and FY2026 outlook on weak back-to-school acquisition (https://live.deutsche-boerse.com/news/EQS-Adhoc-HelloFresh-SE-expects-revenue-for-Q3-2026-below-market-expectations-and-adjusts-outlook-for-the-financial-year-2026-98364f8d-8566-47a6-a9d7-9c39ebc18f63). It is a peer read-through, not a counterparty, and HelloFresh's problem is self-inflicted marketing cuts, so the weight is small.

baseline_tension: The run-up lean (+0.85, from a -17% 20-day fall) argues for a bounce. Finding 1 agrees with it and finding 2 cuts against it; they roughly offset, so I have no edge over the free control on direction.
language_note: The Swedish trading update and Q2 report are word-for-word translations of the English. The Swedish Finwire/Placera telegram added nothing.

FI's Swedish-language insider register (insynsregistret) carried the only thing the English sources did not: board member Olle Qvarnström sold about 158k shares (June and 2026-08-20, at SEK 121-124), and no PDMR has traded since September. It is context, not a finding, because it is stale and does not bear on this print.
The issuer calendar on MFN's Swedish page confirmed the 07:45 timestamp, which the English invitation also gives. Overall, the Swedish sources added nothing to the findings.
lessons_applied: 'The move is in the guide': I moved the Q4-outlook finding onto the guidance scale (-1.0 to -1.5, range widened to -7/+3) and raised abs_move_pct from 8.0 to 9.0, since this name issues a quarterly outlook in every report and its last four report days moved a median of 12%.
'A finding about a number already told is worth 0': I checked that finding 1 sits on EBIT, the one Q3 line not pre-released, and kept it at +1.0. Net sales and customer findings were never filed.
'Reaction history vetoes direction, not size': with the outlook line weighing against the profit line, I pulled p_up from 54 to 50 and left abs_move_pct unshrunk.
'Cash can outweigh a raised guide': I looked for working-capital information and found none, so nothing filed.
